label: COUNTERFACTUAL on recorded replies. The edited replies are not what Qwen sent; nothing here is an official Qwen result. No recorded file was changed.
reading: Both failures came only from the two version fields copied from the request. D4.11 removes both fields from the SELECT request (request version P7_F1_V6_SELECT_REQUEST_V3, pinned by code, plan and request SHA). The reply must still carry exactly protocolVersion P7_F1_V6_SELECT_OBJECTS_V1, and the parser is unchanged: an extra root key is ROOT_KEYS_INVALID, a wrong or missing version is PROTOCOL_VERSION_INVALID, and the extra key is reported first. Whether Qwen stops copying is only known from a new run.
